messages:
maya: Quick heads-up — getting reports of huge latency + 5xxs when na-west hits capacity; customers are seeing auto-reroute to na-east and then 401s. opened ticket #12345
infra-bot: ALERT: region_queue_depth{region="na-west"} = 1124 for 7m; auto_reroute_engaged=true; action=reroute
ryan: Can you paste a repro curl + X-Request-ID? Also which model/route? @eng-runtime please watch
maya: customer sent repro: 
```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" \
  -H "X-Request-ID: abcd1234" \
  -d '{"input":"hello"}' \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```
Response from na-east after reroute: `401 Unauthorized` and a short 50-200ms spike in latency, then a 503 from na-west before reroute.
lucas: looking at runtime logs for that request id:
```
[2025-08-05T14:23:17Z] req=abcd1234 route=na-west shard=hot-7 enqueue=876ms queue_size=980
[2025-08-05T14:23:20Z] req=abcd1234 action=auto_reroute -> na-east reason=queue_exhaustion
[2025-08-05T14:23:21Z] req=abcd1234 auth_check=failed token_scope_mismatch region_bound=na-west
```
ryan: aha — looks like when we auto-reroute we aren't translating the region-bound token or session cookie; token is scoped to na-west so auth fails in na-east. That would explain the 401s. Also cross-region egress caused latency and billing uptick.
priya: seeing a ~12% egress spike for accounts impacted by reroutes in the last 2h. Flagging for finance and account execs.
maya: Customer wants a temp workaround — can we pin this account to na-west or disable auto-reroute for them? Any quick config?
ryan: yes — we can add a customer override to routing policy: `routing.override.account_id=acct_ABC pin_region=na-west`.
Run:
```
infractl apply-policy --account acct_ABC --policy pin-region=na-west
```
That will prevent reroute but could increase latency if queue stays high.
lucas: I'll push a small runtime change to copy a `X-Original-Region` header and try to translate region-scoped auth or fall back to short-lived cross-region tokens. PR: https://git.redwood.ai/eng/runtime/pulls/872
maya: thanks — escalating to oncall @ryan and account execs. I'll add notes to ticket #12345 and propose pin/rollback options. :eyes:
ryan: following up: will coordinate a temporary rate-limit on non-critical traffic to bring na-west queue down. Keep me posted.
infra-bot: NOTE: policy change applied for acct_ABC at 2025-08-05T14:40:05Z by ryan
maya: closing loop here, will update ticket with timeline and costs. thanks team :heart:
